[RDSC.5.5.5] `schema_ref` is required when
`kind == SLOT_KIND_SCHEMA` (a fact-pointer slot) and names
the referenced schema by its own name ([LIMP.13.2]), as the file declaring the
slot resolves it ([LIMP.1.5]). For other kinds the compiler must
leave `schema_ref` empty, and a runtime must ignore it, in an
artefact and in a recording's `Slot` atom ([RFCS.3.2]) alike.
